page.overview:
What is Force drain?

The ability to drain life Force energy from other beings was utilized by various Force-sensitives throughout galactic history.

The draining of Force energy from an individual into oneself was an ability associated to the dark side of the Force and practiced by various figures. This process consisted of the summoning of life energies from others by the practitioner, who then absorbed it.

According to the Imperial adviser Yupe Tashu, some Sith Lords of old drained Force energy from other individuals. By siphoning life from others, the ancient Sith strengthened their connection to the dark side of the Force and extended their own lives by centuries.

The Nightsister shaman Mother Talzin's spirit was able to emerge from the spirit world and into a stone monolith to directly possess the Dark Lord of the Sith Count Dooku, allowing her to drain his life energy and regain her physical form in the process. Green-colored mist emmitted from Dooku's body initially, and at a later phase, the substance flowed from the Count's oral and nasal cavities, as the life force was forcefully taken by Talzin. The victim collapsed screaming in pain.
